description: The Agence nationale des fréquences publishes metadata for a register of radio equipment carried aboard vessels and the identifiers associated with maritime safety. The provider describes MMSI numbers, call signs, open or closed call-sign status and ship-station licence status. Records are grouped by vessel registration number and include vessel name, type, length, tonnage and maritime district. The national catalogue lists monthly updates and public compressed CSV distributions under Licence Ouverte version 2.0. The retained distribution is labelled September 2026 by the provider; its contents have not been opened. The equipment inventory can inform emergency-response planning involving maritime radio assets. Licence status alone does not prove that equipment operates or that a radio link is available. Exact geographic coverage and field completeness remain unverified. The maritime asset scope supersedes the earlier rejection under a digital-only screening. The related ANFR radio-installations record covers a different asset inventory.
